title: The Quiet Protocol
author: Mirabel Sandoval
blurb: Gideon Joubert, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
